announcement.title: Nexora 1.0.2 现已发布
announcement.body:
欢迎升级到 Nexora 1.0.2！本轮更新带来了更灵活的网站分流能力，并全新上线了应用内 Liquid Glass 公告与提示体验：

1. 分流规则支持「指定节点」
现在可以在「路由」页面为任意网站固定指定具体节点或策略组，支持订阅 provider 节点与子域名优先匹配；在规则列表中即可直接切换出口，节点缺失时也会自动提醒。非规则模式下新增顶部一键切换提示。

2. 全新 Liquid Glass 广播公告
重要通知、版本说明与维护提醒现将以原生 Liquid Glass 弹窗呈现，支持静默后台刷新且不打扰正常使用。关闭后可随时在「设置 → 关于 → 公告」中重新查看。

3. 更新弹窗与界面交互优化
「检查更新」结果升级为统一的 Liquid Glass 模态框，并优化了按钮悬停/按压手感和侧边栏无障碍支持。

en.title: Nexora 1.0.2 Is Now Available
en.body:
Welcome to Nexora 1.0.2! This update introduces per-site node pinning along with native Liquid Glass announcements and dialogs:

1. Pin Websites to a Specific Node
In Routing, you can now assign any domain to a specific proxy node or group (including provider nodes), with subdomain-first matching, inline target switching, missing-node warnings, and a one-click switch back to Rule mode.

2. Liquid Glass Broadcast Announcements
Release notices and service reminders now appear in a native Liquid Glass modal with silent background refreshes. You can revisit the latest active announcement anytime under Settings → About → Announcement.

3. Polished Dialogs & Controls
Update check prompts now use the unified Liquid Glass modal, with refined button hover/press hit-testing and improved sidebar accessibility.
